topics.label: Parenting & Family
topics.description: Raising children at any stage — expecting, newborns, toddlers, school age, teens, grown children and grandkids — and family shape: adoption, fostering, step-parenting, single parenting. Not the relationship with a partner.

topics.label: Relationships & Self Care
topics.description: Partners, marriage, intimacy and co-parenting as a relationship, plus a dad's own physical and mental health, burnout and self-care. Not raising the children.

topics.label: Anime & Manga
topics.description: Anime, manga, graphic novels, and visual literature.

topics.label: Books & Reading
topics.description: Books of any genre, book-club selections, reading recommendations, and storytelling.

topics.label: Content Creation & Streaming
topics.description: Making and broadcasting media: filmmaking, video editing, livestreaming games, and creating content; not just watching media.

topics.label: Food & Cooking
topics.description: Cooking, diets, plant-based eating, snacks, and anything else food-related.

topics.label: Home & DIY
topics.description: Home improvement, lawn and garden, backyard projects, decluttering, and do-it-yourself fixes.

topics.label: Humor & Memes
topics.description: Dad jokes, memes, and funny content.

topics.label: LGBTQ+ & Allies
topics.description: Experiences and support for LGBTQ+ dads, parents of LGBTQ+ kids, and allies — not general parenting advice, which belongs under parenting-and-family.

topics.label: Local & Regional Connections
topics.description: Regional threads, timezone-specific chat, and local meetups with nearby members — not travel recommendations or vacation photos.

topics.label: Movies & TV
topics.description: Watching and discussing films, TV series, and live-action adaptations, including movie-club picks; not making films or anime.

topics.label: Music
topics.description: Music, albums, and what dads are listening to.

topics.label: Server News & Help
topics.description: Official announcements, rules, welcome information, help, and how-tos for using the server.

topics.label: Server Suggestions & Feedback
topics.description: Ideas, requests, and feedback for improving the server — channels, bots, emoji, and policies.

topics.label: Social Activities & Events
topics.description: Scheduled community get-togethers, game nights, watch parties, activities, and polls — not individual game discussion or hobby how-tos.

topics.label: Sports & Outdoors
topics.description: Watching or playing sports, outdoor recreation, and exercise as leisure — not health or medical self-care, which belongs under relationships-and-self-care.

topics.label: Technology & Gadgets
topics.description: Everyday tech, software help, apps, and non-gaming gadgets like watches and EDC carries.

topics.label: Video Games
topics.description: Video game titles, platforms, hardware, backlogs, gaming news, and what you're playing — not tabletop or physical games.

critique_notes: No existing tag needs dropping or rewording; the candidate set is internally consistent and complements the fixed parenting/self-care tags.

One notable gap the vocabulary cannot cover: tabletop games — board games, TTRPGs, and physical/analog game discussion like Dice Throne, Pandemic, MTG, and Tabletop Simulator. video-games explicitly excludes tabletop/physical games, and social-activities-and-events only covers scheduled game nights, not individual tabletop discussion. A future dedicated tag would be needed, but I cannot add it here.
